invariants: Model options retain complete provider/model route identity, grouped catalogs, synthesized unlisted selections and exact-model reasoning choices; failed mutations release serialized admission.
Rendering provider-derived defaults does not transfer ownership to the selected Agent route. Explicit controls and persisted adapterDefaults remain distinguishable across resume.
Prompt admission captures a detached future selection before yielding, pins that selection to the exact claimed message/turn for every tool-following step and releases only the exact ended turn.
Validate every prompt block and image before the single attachment batch. Cancellation may leave unreachable stored objects but cannot enqueue a late user message.

Committed assistant/tool events on the exact owned Session produce ordered standard semantic updates; assistant image conversion errors fail only their correlated prompt, supplemental tool-result conversion errors are contained.
Prompt completion and close await owned output drain; close aborts unfinished admission before flush/dispose. Resumed history is not replayed as fresh output.

AgentLoop uses prepared model defaults in actual requests and durable headers, marking only defaults that were materialized; model context capacity is taken from resolved metadata rather than fabricated.
open_questions: Complete stdio/SDK wire envelopes, MCP/permission/subagent consumers and real remote-provider certification remain separate closures; primitive paired projections are not proof of these domains.
identity: Complete provider/model tuple, explicit reasoning effort, exact Agent/Session/message/turn and committed message id.
ownership: ACP owns serialized selected state, admission and output tail; Agent-scoped reversible model-selection listeners route requests; LLM and attachment services own exact model metadata and durable image storage.
ordering: Capture selection, validate all blocks, write one batch, recheck abort/ownership, queue user message, correlate claim and pin, deliver committed projections in order, drain at quiescence, then flush/dispose.
errors: Absent route or invalid choice fails without invented state; initial option failure rolls back activation. Conversion and transport failures retain their distinct settlement behavior.
cancellation: Request abort and cancelled observers keep admission occupied until owned work drains; close aborts an unfinished image write admission and prevents late enqueue.
adaptation: Python 3.8 async service adapters, canonical JSONL/SQLite profiles and eight exact semantic original-source paired projections. No browser changes, MCP capabilities, full stdio parity or Win7 certification are inferred.
